recipes.title: Chipotle Cottage Cheese Alfredo with Crispy Chicken

items.i: taco seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt

steps: Season the chicken thighs generously with taco seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt. Air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 15–20 minutes until crispy and cooked through, then slice.
Cook the penne in salted water until al dente; reserve a splash of pasta water and drain.
Blend the cottage cheese, evaporated milk, Parmesan, chipotle, adobo, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder and salt until completely smooth.
Warm the sauce gently in the pasta pan, then toss in the penne, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Divide between 2 plates and top with the sliced chicken.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-serving macros (625 cal, 63 g protein, 65 g carbs, 14 g fat; makes 2) are from the creator's description. Use half the chipotle for less heat.
